desc: Beretta is bringing back the classic .380 with exceptional comfort & style. The Beretta 80X Cheetah pistol reimagines the legendary platform, with a new sleek design and enhanced features. Ergonomically redesigned for modern day carry, the 80X Cheetah includes a smaller Vertec style grip profile, the X-treme S Double/Single trigger, a skeletonized hammer, and comes optics-ready out of the box.
